definition: to cook food in hot oil in a pan
description: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

de.answer: Er brät Fisch in einer Pfanne.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está friendo pescado en una sartén.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il fait frire du poisson dans une poêle.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
